decision: Ship at warning with mixed-type unions and nullable enums reported; nullable strings, numbers and booleans, plain strings and numbers, nullable objects and any stay allowed. No autofix.
priorReview: opinionated-design-100-passes-20261019.json pass 18: the rule does not prevent boolean selector parameters, so @sarj/no-boolean-selector-parameter keeps that invariant.
type-guard-design-50-passes.json G10: filter(Boolean) stays with prefer-nullish-filter-predicate. Neither review measured or rejected the rule itself.

corpora.excluded: generated plugin bundles and the bundled action parser

optionSets.dominantKinds: 563 nullable strings and 83 nullable booleans where an empty string or undefined is meant to read as absent
the upstream-default findings plus 199 string and 12 number checks; the number checks are mostly length and size tests

realBugKinds: primitive-or-array fixed value coerced with || "", turning 0 and false into an empty request value
the same fallback in the fixed-value editor, rendering 0 as an empty input
boolean|number|string test value read with || "", so a chosen false shows as unselected
number|string chart value tested by truthiness, hiding a 0 data point in the tooltip
optionSets.noiseKinds: ReactNode and string-or-element props tested for presence; server.address() narrowing; literal-value truthiness in rule code that emulates JavaScript semantics

missedByShippedOptions: One number-truthiness bug (a validator rejecting 0 that the schema allows) needs allowNumber: false, which adds 12 private findings of which 11 are length or size checks.

existingOwners.@sarj/no-logical-or-fallback: excludes unions with array or boolean members, so it misses three of the four fallbacks
existingOwners.typescript/prefer-nullish-coalescing: reports the nullable test-value fallback; the consumer baseline already absorbs that finding
existingOwners.react-js/jsx-no-leaked-render: accepts ternaries, so it misses the chart tooltip
existingOwners.typescript/no-unnecessary-condition: reports constant truthiness only; it overlaps the three always-truthy object findings

performance.method: Five interleaved runs on the private corpus, no-unnecessary-condition alone versus with this rule, shared machine

rollout: Consumer baselines absorb existing findings. Consumers that raise managed warnings to errors block new mixed-union conditions immediately.
promotion: Error needs a separate change after a warning release; 24 of 44 inspected private findings are noise.
